design_overview: One nonadaptive batch spanning native-shaped recycle-site placement, persistent history-address dataflow, retirement skip edges, dispatch lowering, callback-safe parameter stages, selection-loop layout and structured command outcomes. Each source is a full independent TU derived from the frozen baseline. X03 explicitly combines the two separately motivated recycle-layout hypotheses.
domain_assumptions: Native O32 object layouts, valid table indices and list links, and Entry-array storage distinct from global pointer/control objects.
No asynchronous or volatile mutation beyond the same explicit callback boundaries represented by the baseline.
Original signed-counter arithmetic is source-defined; float-to-integer conversions stay in the baseline-defined domains.
No callback-sensitive table, node entry, list-head or later-parameter reload is intentionally cached across callbacks.
limitations: The exported real MP_TargetSteerPos ordinary ABI remains fixed and differs from the native private-register call convention.
No new helper contract, float conversion domain or arithmetic sequence is introduced.
Only the common structural/context/parser check is run by this lane. Coordinator owns uniform C89 and bounded differential validation plus the single machine batch.
Structural checking and bounded tests cannot prove native gameplay equivalence.
Some authentic spelling/dataflow variants may compile identically; unique source hashes do not imply unique ELFs.
Timing includes an interrupted prior session and resumed evidence read; see timing-notes.json and the unaltered event records. Active inference time is unknown.
No sibling sources or scores were inspected, no candidates were compiled locally, and no post-score replacement is permitted.
